Specification: This module demonstrates how to use TLC's Print operator inside assumptions to calculate and display the values of TLA+ expressions during model checking. It defines a helper operator PrintVal that prints an identifier together with an expression value, and then uses a single conjunctive ASSUME block so TLC prints the selected values in a desired order. The spec is not a transition-system algorithm with variables or temporal behavior; it is a small utility-style module focused on expression evaluation, records, record update with EXCEPT, arithmetic, and TLC output.
AssumptionNames:
/\ PrintVal("Three more cats: ",
              [cat |-> 1, dog |-> "d"].cat + 3)
  /\ PrintVal("Here's a record: ",
              [ [game |-> "baseball", player |-> "Marris", homers |-> 61]
                   EXCEPT !.player = "McGuire",
                          !.homers = @+9 ] )
FunctionApplication:
PrintVal("Here's a record: ",
              [ [game |-> "baseball", player |-> "Marris", homers |-> 61]
                   EXCEPT !.player = "McGuire",
                          !.homers = @+9 ] )
